reason: In crypto/default/src/main/java/org/keycloak/crypto/def/BCECDSACryptoProvider.java:28-35 (as well as crypto/fips1402/src/main/java/org/keycloak/crypto/fips/BCFIPSECDSACryptoProvider.java:28-35 and crypto/elytron/src/main/java/org/keycloak/crypto/elytron/ElytronECDSACryptoProvider.java:37-44), concatenatedRSToASN1DER() copies len = signLength / 2 bytes twice via System.arraycopy without checking signature.length, so a shorter malformed signature throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException instead of the declared IOException. Callers such as core/src/main/java/org/keycloak/crypto/ECDSASignatureVerifierContext.java:27-35 catch Exception and wrap it in VerificationException, and the underlying ECDSACryptoProvider implementations are pre-existing code.
